findings.text: non-blocking: _archive_label_counts re-implements the existing offsite.read_archive_manifest (the tar-walk for the single manifest.json member and its JSON parse) at iter_codex/graph/offsite.py:166 without extending it, and drops the int-coercion and raise-on-failure that GraphCensus.from_manifest performs, so two readers of the same archive manifest now exist and can drift.

non-blocking: the "Plant export" table row closes after the path cell and then emits the "--facility X --without-dd" parenthetical as a loose text node with a stray , so that note renders outside the Path column and the row is malformed HTML.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit — a01663fba adds the archive-scope decision (registry.py:552 _archive_label_counts, ghcr.py:812 facility_owned_labels, ghcr.py:830 dump_holds_facility_content) and the remote tag-after-check, and a3812f9e adds the evidence fragment; 7 files, +541/-41.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests per push path plus a negative control; tests/cli/test_graph_push_private_package.py covers full-graph, facility-filtered, cycle, remote, DD-only and the manifestless archive, and the manifest records the after arm at 59 passed/EXIT=0 and the negative control at 1 failed/EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that a graph push carrying facility nodes fails unless its registry package reads back private; iter_codex/cli/graph/registry.py:877 and :985 call _require_private_package after the write on the remote and local paths and ghcr.py:585 raises on anything but private.
item_verdicts.manifest: the reviewed manifest is status complete and records commits a01663fba and a3812f9e with a base arm of 49 passed and an after arm of 59 passed, both EXIT=0, plus a negative-control log; I read both suite-log tails and the negative-control log on disk and they agree.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared paths are iter_codex/cli/graph/registry.py, iter_codex/graph/ghcr.py, iter_codex/graph/remote.py, tests/cli, tests/graph and one evidence fragment; all seven files in dc6950fa..a3812f9e lie inside them and tests/graph was not needed.

justifications.durability: tests/cli/test_graph_push_private_package.py:228 reddens when _require_private_package returns early, as logs/negative-control.log shows 1 failed/EXIT=1, and test_dd_only_push_never_queries_visibility (line 263) fails the test if a DD-only archive queries the registry.
justifications.evidence: the manifest's gate command runs the graph CLI suite on both arms and the on-disk logs end "59 passed"/"49 passed" with EXIT=0, so the done_when measure is recorded rather than claimed.
justifications.fit: the additions follow the surrounding registry.py and ghcr.py idiom and carry no plan, version or ticket identifiers; only registry.py:552 diverges from the sibling reader's raise-on-failure convention.
justifications.goal_fidelity: registry.py:985 decides from the archive's own label_counts and registry.py:877 from the remote whole-graph scope, each failing via ghcr.py:585 before the latest tag, while a DD-only push skips through ghcr.py:830.
justifications.reuse: registry.py:552 _archive_label_counts re-implements iter_codex/graph/offsite.py:166 read_archive_manifest rather than extending it.
justifications.scope_discipline: every one of the seven changed files (registry.py, ghcr.py, remote.py, three tests/cli files, one evidence fragment) is inside the declared write paths and nothing else was touched.
